plan: A duelist who strikes her enemies' weak points to take them down in a duel.
aSurveiller: Her W (Riposte). She parries all your damage and crowd control for a moment: if you stun her during it, you get stunned.
contrer: Don't use your crowd control right after her W: her parry would turn it against you.
Don't leave your weak points exposed: move so she hits them less.
Fight her with your allies: she is very strong in duels but less so in teams.
forces: Parries crowd control with her W.

sorts.P: Reveals a weak point; hitting it heals and speeds her up.
sorts.Q: Lunges in a direction and strikes.
sorts.W: Parries all damage, then strikes; stuns if she parries crowd control.
sorts.E: Two quick attacks: a slow then a critical hit.
sorts.R: Reveals 4 weak points; hitting them creates a healing zone.

momentFort: Strong from the start, and fearsome in the late game in duels.
